keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1450-1963: Karagwe. The page gives no area or boundary and says the kingdom lay 'between Rwanda and Lake Victoria' in Karagwe District; 'The interlacustrine territory had been ruled by Bunyoro up until the end of the eighteenth century' and 'By 1800, the Baganda had assassinated the Hinda king of Kyamutwara at his court'. The drawn circle is the researcher's reading and stands for the whole life; the German takeover is not on the page.

notes:
New state (Cliopatria has no Karagwe row). One page: Karagwe Kingdom. It is silent on the German period (nothing on Bukoba, a treaty of the 1890s, or the incorporation into German East Africa), so the dossier runs to the page's 6 December 1963; from the 1890s Karagwe was a protected kingdom inside German East Africa and then Tanganyika, which a gap-filler must date from a page on German East Africa or on Bukoba. No German-period event is recorded because none was found on a page opened.

Disagreements: Rumanyika I 1855-1882 (text) or 1853-1883 (list); Ruhinda's founding 'c. 1450' (the brief's expectation of the 15th-16th century is the legend). The list in the extract skips the reigns of 1883-1916 (Kayango and others are not on it).

Counterparts needing dossiers: tanzania (a Cliopatria row from 1961), german-africa (af-08), Kyamutwara and the other Haya states (none), Buha (none). Gazetteer names needed: Karagwe, Bweranyange (coordinates assumed).
